 **

*
 ORDER Heard both sides.
2. The petition mentioned lands have been acquired under the provisions of Tamil Nadu Highways Act 2001.
Award was passed on 16.10.2023 determining the quantum of compensation.
The petitioner seeks enhancement.
Section 20(1) of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act, 2001 reads as follows:-

Any person aggrieved by the decision of the Collector, or the officer to whom the case was transferred, determining the amount may, within sixty days from the date of such decision, in so far as it affects him, by application to the Collector or the officer to whom the case was transferred, require that the matter be referred by him for the determination of the Court as defined in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894(Central Act 1 of 1894), and when any such application is made, the provisions of Part III of the said Act shall mutatis mutandis apply to further proceedings in respect thereof.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
The petitioner submitted his application on 10.11.2023.
The statute contemplates that within sixty days reference has to be made.
The first respondent is directed to make reference as contemplated in the statutory provisions immediately and without any delay.
On such reference being made, it shall be taken on file and disposed of by the jurisdictional civil Court as expeditiously as possible.
4. With this direction to the first respondent, this writ petition stands allowed.
No costs.
